gotchas: VE.Bus BMS V1 (BMS300200000) is NOT in this list and must not be added to it. The vendor BMS overview datasheet's Data communication row reads, for VE.Bus BMS: 'VE.Bus communication only direct with inverter/charger(s), not with a GX device.' It is also marked 'End-of-life, use a VE.Bus BMS V2 instead'. It has no route

VE.Bus BMS V2's own manual is explicit that it does NOT pass battery data through itself the way the V1 did: its GX role is 'On/off/charger-only control of VE.Bus products via a GX device' and 'GX DVCC control of solar chargers'. Whether battery voltage, cell state or alarms appear as readable values on the GX is not s
VE.Bus BMS V2 requires inverter/charger VE.Bus firmware ≥ xxxx415 or the system throws VE.Bus error 15 and the BMS cannot be used at all. Devices below that and not updatable must use the V1 instead.

The VE.Bus BMS V2 and NG cannot run without a VE.Bus inverter/charger: 'the BMS cannot be used without a VE.Bus Inverter/charger or a VE.Bus inverter' — it takes its negative from the VE.Bus. That is a hard system prerequisite before any of this telemetry exists.
